anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Birth from above / water; another beginning.

choices.why: New conduct after leaving darkness, tied to baptism.

pass_a_gloss: and it is for the one crossing then a beginning of months, when the month of the crossing of Egypt comes to be, so that for him a beginning of another birth comes to be, a new way of life coming to be for one leaving the darkness and coming toward the light — I speak fittingly as toward the sign given through water to those who have hoped in Christ, which has been named washing of regeneration. For what else does regeneration signify than a beginning of another coming-to-be?
pass_b_english: And for the one who crosses, that is then a beginning of months, when the month of the crossing from Egypt comes. So for him a beginning of another birth comes: a new way of life for the one who has left the darkness and is coming to the light. I speak of the sign given through water to those who have hoped in Christ, which has been named a washing of regeneration. For what else does regeneration mean but the beginning of another birth (Titus 3:5) (John 3:3–5) (Colossians 1:12–13) (1 Peter 2:9)?
